# GMEOW Evidence Module

The GMEOW Evidence Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/evidence>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/evidence`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Evidential warrant and source-typing substrate: two orthogonal axes that travel with the evidence link (CitationAct / EvidenceSpan) rather than the asserted fact.

Axis A — Evidential warrant (strength/kind of evidence for a fact). An open value vocabulary gmeow:EvidenceClass reached by a non-functional property gmeow:hasEvidenceClass. A multi-source claim legitimately carries several evidence classes (Principle 9).

Axis B — Source independence and coverage typing (for notability, not truth). Four properties on the citation: gmeow:sourceIndependence, gmeow:sourceTier, gmeow:coverageDepth, and gmeow:supportsNotability. These are explicitly orthogonal to evidential warrant: a primary legal filing may verify a fact (high warrant) without establishing notability (supportsNotability false).

CONSTITUTIONAL GROUNDING: P1 (no SOTA vocabulary unifies these axes), P5 (maximal bridging by reference to CRMinf, PROV-O, schema.org, C2PA, DataCite, nanopublications, WP:GNG), P9 (co-equal facets, no privileged single winner), P10 (suppression by projection, never erasure), P12 (eligibility decisions live in the solver layer).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/evidence>
